plain: Opening a Disclosure row no longer makes the rows below jump, so delete any override of its inline gap or .overflow-hidden you added as a workaround.

steps.plain: Disclosure's wrapper is now a plain div without the Stack data attributes, and a row's preview stays mounted, hidden from assistive technology, while the row is open, so update a selector or test that relied on either.
Timeline renders a Disclosure, so its wrapper loses the Stack data attributes too; update a selector or test that relied on them.
